The document provides detailed information on the configuration settings and current status of ollama serving posture on the RX 9070 XT, including the use of systemd units, pinned FIM runners, and baked KV cache settings. Key decisions include baking a fixed number of context slots (num_ctx) for each tag served on Timmy, setting the number of parallel requests (OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL) to 2, and using a near-lossless KV cache type (OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE) to reduce memory usage. The current status is that follow-up actions are planned to reclaim VRAM by lowering num_ctx to 8192.
